APPROVE
The cases are preserved: `UnusedWriteScopeGrants` now holds only the file loop and one call. Its logic is split across two helpers, each well under 15. The inverted top-level condition is a correct De Morgan rewrite that keeps the same short-circuit order, so `TopLevelPermissionsIndex` runs under the same conditions. Results come out in the same per-file order, and the moved code reuses the same types and identifiers, so it should still build.
